ai.title: Pengaturan AI
ai.description: Konfigurasikan fitur berbasis AI seperti kategorisasi transaksi otomatis

tabs.invalidConnectionsTooltip: One of your AI models needs attention

features.title: Fitur AI
features.description: Konfigurasikan model mana yang digunakan untuk setiap fitur berbasis AI

points.autoSync: Saat Anda menyinkronkan transaksi dari bank, transasi yang tidak terkategorikan otomatis dikirim ke AI untuk dikategorikan.
points.analysis: AI menganalisis deskripsi transaksi dan nama merchant untuk menyarankan kategori yang sesuai dari daftar kategori Anda.
points.override: Anda selalu dapat mengganti kategori yang disarankan AI secara manual.

points.upload: Upload laporan bank (PDF, CSV, atau TXT) dan AI akan mengekstrak semua transaksi secara otomatis.
points.analysis: AI menganalisis struktur dokumen untuk mengidentifikasi tanggal, deskripsi, jumlah, dan jenis transaksi.
points.review: Anda dapat meninjau dan mengoreksi data yang diekstrak sebelum mengimpor ke akun Anda.
points.cost: Biaya diperkirakan sebelum diproses, namun hanya mencerminkan perkiraan biaya.

badges.yourKeyTooltip: Fitur ini menggunakan kunci API pribadi Anda. Anda memiliki kendali penuh atas penggunaan dan biaya, tanpa batasan jumlah dari server kami.
badges.serverTooltip: Fitur ini menggunakan kunci API bersama server kami. Gratis tetapi mungkin memiliki batasan jumlah saat permintaan tinggi. Tambahkan kunci API Anda sendiri untuk akses tak terbatas.

modelSelector.sharedPoolNote: On your current plan, the included model runs in a shared pool, so limits may apply when overall demand is high. {link} to avoid them.

empty.title: No AI model yet
empty.description: Add your own AI model to use this feature.

modelSelector.allConnectionsDown: All your AI models need attention, so this feature is paused. Fix one in {link}.

why.categorization: A short, repetitive job. A small model handles it well and keeps the cost down.
why.statementParsing: Reads the whole statement and writes back every row, so it needs a model that stays accurate over long text.
why.investmentTransactionsParsing: Turns broker exports into buy and sell rows. Long exports need a model that can write long answers.
why.receiptParsing: The model looks at the invoice file itself, so it has to read images and PDFs.

picks.statementParsing: Gemini Flash · Claude Sonnet · GPT Terra

longAnswers.label: Long answers
longAnswers.fail: Writes up to {tokens} tokens, so long files get cut off.

structuredAnswers.label: Structured answers
structuredAnswers.fail: Its answers may come back in a shape the app can't read.

unknown.title: Can't check this model
unknown.detail: models.dev has no details for this model right now, so we can't check it. Make sure it covers the needs above.

connections.title: AI models
connections.description: Connect OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter or a local model. Each entry is one model you can pick for any feature.

tip.text: You can add the same provider more than once with different models. Name them by how smart they are, like 'Claude smart' and 'Claude fast', then pick the right one for each feature.

connections.capReached: You've reached the limit of {max} AI models. Remove one to add another.

empty.title: No AI models yet
empty.description: Add a model with your own API key, or connect a local one like Ollama or LM Studio.

loadError.title: Couldn't load your AI models
loadError.description: Your saved models are still there. Check your connection and try again.

form.apiKeyOptionalHint: Optional. Leave blank if your server doesn't need a key.
form.apiKeySavedHint: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
form.apiKeyBorrowedHint: Uses the key from "{name}". Type a new key to use a different one.
form.modelListEmpty: No models to pick from. Type the model name your server uses.
form.modelListNoMatch: No listed model matches. You can still use the name you typed.
form.localNetworkOnly: MoneyMatter can't reach a server on your own computer, like {hostname} or {ip}. Expose it through a tunnel such as ngrok or Cloudflare Tunnel, then paste the tunnel's URL here.
form.dockerHost: If you run this app in Docker on the same machine as the model server, use {dockerHost} instead of {ip}.

customInstructions.title: Instruksi Kustom
customInstructions.description: Berikan konteks untuk membantu AI mengkategorikan transaksi Anda. Instruksi ini disertakan saat mengkategorikan transaksi selama sinkronisasi bank dan impor manual.
customInstructions.placeholder: Mis: Transaksi dari 'Starbucks' harus 'Kopi'. Pemasukan lepas saya berasal dari 'Acme Corp'.
customInstructions.serverModelHint: Custom instructions only apply when one of your own AI models handles categorization. Pick one above.
customInstructions.requiresOwnCredentials: Tambahkan kunci API Anda sendiri atau endpoint kustom untuk menggunakan instruksi kustom.
customInstructions.credentialsCheckFailed: Kami tidak dapat memeriksa apakah Anda memiliki kredensial AI sendiri. Coba lagi untuk membuka instruksi kustom.
customInstructions.saveFailed: Gagal menyimpan instruksi kustom. Silakan coba lagi.
